purpose: Additive PR358 remediation checks; frozen questions and historical results remain unchanged.

questions.query: Does erasing Activated Binder conserve free and bound Water, and does its native edit receipt account for bound destruction?
facts: Curing transfers free Water into bound stateB, and Crust retains it.
Generic erase/repaint can destroy bound Water without adding a free-Water sink; separate before/after bound-loss accounting is required.
Exact free plus overfill plus bound closure applies to closed-cure fixtures without edits or destructive chemistry.

questions.query: Can old CYPS2 or IN-only CYPS3 physical checkpoints load after the paired-material quantity schema grows from19 to20 kernel slots?
facts: Nested quantity schema1 is refused before incompatible arrays are interpreted; outer CYPS version alone does not establish compatibility.
The break also affects checkpoints containing only old materials.
The owner must accept versioned refusal or separately authorize a tested migration; no migration is implemented.

questions.query: Can CYSD1 reconstruct an8-bit Activated Binder with bound255 under3-bit Water precision and silently rescale it?
facts: CYSD1 preserves the stateB byte and has no source mass-precision profile; it does not rescale or validate cross-profile bound quantity.
Binder level exchange requires matching precision; low-level cross-profile reconstruction is unsupported.
The paired lab is fixed8-bit and has no import UI; controlled scenario save/import refuses and ordinary reconstruction resets default8-bit. CYPS restores its own saved precision.
